posts.title: Breaking Up with 1Password after 15 Years
posts.description: After 15 years, 1Password's response to my concerns about their donations to Omarchy prompted me to switch to Proton Pass.

posts.title: Maintaining Git History when Spinning Out a Subdirectory
posts.description: A quick summary of how to maintain git history when moving a subdirectory of a larger project out into its own repository, e.g. when open sourcing a monorepo component.
